provenance.note: This replaces the prior verbatim JSON conversion. Original clinical claims remain only in the source CSV/history.

interpretation: Evidence supports particular measurements in specified studies; it does not prove universal diagnostic performance. Requirements/priorities and current-clip assessments are project judgments, not literature results.

setup.evidence_for_exact_combination: Not established by the cited studies.

output_policy.missing_measurements: Use null with an explicit not_measured, ungradable, or not_calibrated status; never invent numeric values.
output_policy.clinical_inference: Do not map image measurements directly to disease diagnoses.
output_policy.evaluation: Use independent references and participant-level splits; model-generated predictions are not ground truth.

targets.name: Calibrated scleral chromaticity

measurements.name: scleral_chromaticity_xy
measurements.definition: Summarize calibrated CIE xy in a valid scleral ROI, excluding vessels and reflections.
measurements.evidence_status: Related calibrated colorimetry approach studied in L02; exact ROI summary must be prespecified.

measurements.name: scleral_lab_b_star
measurements.definition: Optional descriptive feature after a defined color transform and white point.
measurements.evidence_status: Project exploratory feature; not itself a validated bilirubin estimator.

targets.supported_statement: Calibrated smartphone scleral color has shown association with measured bilirubin in a cirrhosis cohort.
claims_not_supported_for_this_project: This system diagnoses hepatitis, cirrhosis, or obstruction from a video.
capture_requirements: Device/attachment-specific color calibration and controlled documented illumination.
Sufficient scleral coverage; exclude clipping, glare, vessels and eyelids.
Preserve documented color encoding/exposure; validate processing across recordings.
validation_reference: Paired serum bilirubin and independent subject-held-out testing.
Repeat-capture error and prediction agreement, not correlation alone.

current_clip_assessment.basis: project engineering judgment from manual review, not a published result

targets.name: Conjunctival vessel coverage and redness

measurements.name: vessel_area_fraction
measurements.definition: Segmented vessel pixels / valid conjunctival ROI pixels.
measurements.evidence_status: L04 tested vessel-density associations with expert redness grades.

measurements.name: vessel_tortuosity
measurements.definition: Vessel centerline path length / endpoint distance, with defined segment selection and aggregation.
measurements.evidence_status: Distinct from area fraction; weak association with grading in L04; secondary exploratory feature.

targets.supported_statement: Automated vessel coverage can correlate with manual hyperemia grading in slit-lamp photographs.
claims_not_supported_for_this_project: Redness alone diagnoses dry eye or allergy.
Vessel tortuosity and red-pixel fraction are the same measurement.
This metric is already a validated primary endpoint for anti-inflammatory trials.
capture_requirements: Standardized conjunctival region, exposure, white balance and illumination.
Resolve vessels; exclude iris, eyelids, reflections and out-of-focus tissue.
validation_reference: Independent conjunctiva/vessel masks and expert redness grades.
Subject-held-out mask accuracy, grading agreement and repeatability.

current_clip_assessment.basis: project engineering judgment from manual review, not a published result

targets.name: Palpebral conjunctival color for anemia research

measurements.name: palpebral_conjunctival_color_features
measurements.definition: Use an explicitly specified color-feature method on inner-eyelid tissue; do not substitute sclera.
measurements.evidence_status: L03 tested RAW conjunctival color-based hemoglobin estimation; no estimator implemented here.

targets.supported_statement: Smartphone inner-eyelid imaging has been investigated for anemia estimation against laboratory hemoglobin, with material individual error.
claims_not_supported_for_this_project: Scleral whiteness is a validated anemia endpoint.
Reduced a* or vessel visibility directly measures perfusion.
The prototype replaces laboratory hemoglobin testing.
capture_requirements: A separately designed protocol exposing palpebral conjunctiva, with suitable clinical input.
Document color capture, illumination and tissue ROI.
validation_reference: Paired laboratory hemoglobin and independent subject-held-out cases.
Report sensitivity/specificity at defined thresholds and hemoglobin error/agreement.

current_clip_assessment.basis: project engineering judgment from manual review, not a published result

targets.name: Pupil-to-visible-iris diameter ratio

measurements.name: pupil_to_iris_ratio
measurements.definition: D_pupil_px / D_visible_iris_px, using a consistent fitted-diameter convention.
measurements.evidence_status: Normalized pupil/limbus sizing is used in L01; our segmentation must be validated.

targets.supported_statement: Smartphone recordings can support normalized pupil measurements under a defined capture protocol.
claims_not_supported_for_this_project: A population mean iris diameter of 11.8 mm is individual calibration.
The 15x lens rating provides mm-per-pixel scale.
Pupil ratio alone diagnoses drug toxicity or autonomic disease.
capture_requirements: Visible pupil/limbus boundaries with sufficient focus and limited reflection/occlusion.
Document gaze and lighting; reject incomplete or unreliable fits.
validation_reference: Independent boundary annotations and ratio measurements.
Geometric error, repeatability and agreement across subjects/sessions.

current_clip_assessment.basis: project engineering judgment from manual review, not a published result

targets.name: Stimulus-aligned pupillary light response

measurements.name: percent_constriction
measurements.definition: 100 * (D_baseline - D_min) / D_baseline; baseline is a defined pre-response interval tied to stimulus timing.
measurements.evidence_status: Response amplitude supported under L01 protocol; not spontaneous max/min over an arbitrary movie.

measurements.name: normalized_constriction_velocity
measurements.definition: Negative time derivative of pupil-to-iris ratio during a prespecified constriction interval.
measurements.evidence_status: Project extension requiring validation; not a validated L01 clinical diagnostic output.

measurements.name: response_latency
measurements.definition: Time from known stimulus onset to a prespecified detected constriction onset.
measurements.evidence_status: Requires independent timing validation; L01 did not compare latency between systems.

measurements.name: absolute_constriction_velocity
measurements.definition: Negative derivative of calibrated physical pupil diameter.
measurements.evidence_status: Disabled until individual spatial calibration and temporal validation exist.

targets.supported_statement: A controlled iPhone study demonstrated agreement for pupil response measurements against infrared pupillometry.
claims_not_supported_for_this_project: Untimed ordinary video establishes a light reflex.
Sparse selected stills recover reliable response velocity.
This prototype diagnoses concussion, brainstem injury, or cranial nerve III dysfunction.
capture_requirements: Defined stimulus intensity/duration/onset and ambient adaptation protocol.
Full temporal sequence, reliable frame timestamps, validated sampling rate and blink rejection.
Do not improvise intense-light exposure; establish an appropriate protocol with clinical input.
validation_reference: Synchronized reference pupillometer and agreement analyses.
Separate clinical cohorts and diagnostic references for any later disease claim.

current_clip_assessment.basis: project engineering judgment from manual review, not a published result

targets.name: Peripheral corneal opacity / arcus appearance

measurements.name: expert_referenced_arcus_presence
measurements.definition: Present / absent / ungradable relative to independent clinical grading.
measurements.evidence_status: Clinical arcus was assessed in L05; automated macro detection is a project proposal.

measurements.name: peripheral_opacity_extent
measurements.definition: Proposed visible circumferential extent after peripheral-cornea localization and glare exclusion.
measurements.evidence_status: Exploratory; the imported luminance-ring index has not been validated by the cited study.

targets.supported_statement: Arcus is a clinically observed corneal finding; its cardiovascular association is population-dependent and can be explained by age.
claims_not_supported_for_this_project: A bright limbal ring is necessarily arcus.
Image luminance quantifies cholesterol or cardiovascular risk.
The iris boundary itself is arcus.
capture_requirements: Visible peripheral cornea with controlled illumination and sufficient coverage.
Distinguish glare and other opacity patterns using expert labels.
validation_reference: Independent clinical/slit-lamp arcus grading for appearance detection.
Separate lipid measurements and outcome cohorts for any systemic-risk hypothesis.

current_clip_assessment.basis: project engineering judgment from manual review, not a published result
